title: Battle of Quiévrain (1792)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Quiévrain (1792)", at revision 1379857932, opens: "The Battle of Quiévrain was a pair of skirmishes between the Habsburg monarchy and the Kingdom of France in late April 1792 during the War of the First Coalition." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2984860, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1792 battle of the War of the First Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
